codeReview.summary: Rerun still fails. Reviewing current HEAD shows the same two blocking gaps as the prior review: `generateSpeech()` still falls through to OpenAI when the Sarvam circuit is open even if `providerFallbackEnabled` is false, and `__tests__/tts-provider.test.ts` still never imports or executes the real provider. File history for the reviewed paths shows no follow-up changes after the original provider/test commits.

issues.description: The circuit-open fallback bug remains. When `checkCircuitBreaker('sarvam_tts')` returns false, line 180 sets `fallbackReason = 'sarvam_tts_circuit_open'` and execution then falls straight into the OpenAI branch at lines 183-195 without checking `providerFallbackEnabled`. Requests with `client_capabilities.provider_fallback_enabled = false` can therefore still receive OpenAI audio whenever the Sarvam circuit is open.

Meaningful module coverage is still missing. This suite still consists of tautological assertions over local literals/hand-rolled state (for example `const expectedModel = 'bulbul:v3'` at line 141 and `expect(callCount).toBe(2)` at line 421) and never imports or calls `generateSpeech()`. A current repo-wide search for `generateSpeech(` only finds `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/handlers/main.ts` and `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/providers/tts.ts`, so VAL-BE-014/015/016/017 still lack real automated verification.
